options.content: Risk decisions, execution gates, order sync lifecycle, and adapter health.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  to_timestamp((CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) / 1000.0) AS "time",
  (e.exchange || ' ' || e.symbol) AS metric,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['risk','approved'], 'false') = 'true' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS value
FROM mm_events e
WHERE e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange IN (${exchange:sqlstring})
  AND e.symbol IN (${symbol:sqlstring})
  AND e.actor_id IN (${actor_id:sqlstring})
  AND ($__timeFilter(e.ts))
  AND e.payload->>'t_end_ms' IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  to_timestamp((CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) / 1000.0) AS "time",
  reason.key AS metric,
  SUM(CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(reason.value, '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(reason.value, ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END) AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(COALESCE(e.payload #> ARRAY['risk','rejection_counts'], '{}'::jsonb)) AS reason(key, value)
WHERE e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange IN (${exchange:sqlstring})
  AND e.symbol IN (${symbol:sqlstring})
  AND e.actor_id IN (${actor_id:sqlstring})
  AND ($__timeFilter(e.ts))
  AND e.payload->>'t_end_ms' IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  to_timestamp((CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) / 1000.0) AS "time",
  reason.value AS metric,
  COUNT(*)::double precision AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(e.payload #> ARRAY['execution_gates','blocked_reasons'], '[]'::jsonb)) AS reason(value)
WHERE e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange IN (${exchange:sqlstring})
  AND e.symbol IN (${symbol:sqlstring})
  AND e.actor_id IN (${actor_id:sqlstring})
  AND ($__timeFilter(e.ts))
  AND e.payload->>'t_end_ms' IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  to_timestamp((CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) / 1000.0) AS "time",
  (COALESCE(e.exchange, 'unknown') || ' ' ||
   CASE e.event_type WHEN 'ExecutionSyncCompleted' THEN 'completed' ELSE 'failed' END) AS metric,
  COUNT(*)::double precision AS value
FROM mm_events e
WHERE e.event_type IN ('ExecutionSyncCompleted', 'ExecutionSyncFailed')
  AND e.payload->>'t_end_ms' IS NOT NULL
  AND e.exchange IN (${exchange:sqlstring})
  AND (e.symbol IN (${symbol:sqlstring}) OR e.symbol IS NULL)
  AND $__timeFilter(to_timestamp((CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) / 1000.0))
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  to_timestamp((CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) / 1000.0) AS "time",
  (COALESCE(e.exchange, 'unknown') || ' ' ||
   CASE WHEN e.event_type = 'CancelOrdersFailed' THEN 'cancel' ELSE 'place' END || ' ' ||
   COALESCE(NULLIF(e.payload->>'error', ''), 'unknown')) AS metric,
  COUNT(*)::double precision AS value
FROM mm_events e
WHERE e.event_type IN ('CancelOrdersFailed', 'PlaceOrdersFailed')
  AND e.payload->>'t_end_ms' IS NOT NULL
  AND e.exchange IN (${exchange:sqlstring})
  AND (e.symbol IN (${symbol:sqlstring}) OR e.symbol IS NULL)
  AND $__timeFilter(to_timestamp((CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) / 1000.0))
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  to_timestamp((CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) / 1000.0) AS "time",
  (COALESCE(e.exchange, 'unknown') || ' ' || COALESCE(NULLIF(e.payload->>'reason', ''), 'unknown')) AS metric,
  COUNT(*)::double precision AS value
FROM mm_events e
WHERE e.event_type = 'OrderValidationRejected'
  AND e.payload->>'t_end_ms' IS NOT NULL
  AND e.exchange IN (${exchange:sqlstring})
  AND (e.symbol IN (${symbol:sqlstring}) OR e.symbol IS NULL)
  AND $__timeFilter(to_timestamp((CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) / 1000.0))
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

SELECT ts, topic, event_type, exchange, symbol, actor_id, payload
FROM mm_events
WHERE topic LIKE 'execution:%'
  AND exchange IN (${exchange:sqlstring})
  AND (symbol IN (${symbol:sqlstring}) OR symbol IS NULL)
  AND $__timeFilter(ts)
ORDER BY ts DESC
LIMIT 50
